note: The shade audit's 'Add first' table (docs/plant-data/shade-audit.md): the staples the Shade Perennials tab had no genus of. Natives read against the Wildflower Center and New Moon or the Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder; the rest against the Plant Finder. Where sources disagree, estimates says which value was taken and why.
